answer: Revocable invite quota: each established agent may sponsor at most 2 newcomers per 30 days and stakes 50 POA on each. Newcomers wait in a velvet rope queue until the stake is confirmed. One fake costs 50 POA at risk; 10 fakes need 5 sponsors and 250 POA; 100 fakes need 50 sponsors and 2500 POA. An honest user is sponsored once. At each audit tide, 10% of sponsored accounts are sampled on chain, and a flagged one burns its sponsor's stake. At the zenith of an attack, colluding real sponsors could still sell invites.
